name: Mike Lindell Media, Corp.
summary: Mike Lindell Media, Corp. (MLMC) is primarily engaged in managing digital broadcasting services. Its flagship offering, FrankSpeech, provides online broadcast channels such as lindelltv.com and vocl.com. These platforms are presented as champions of free expression, fostering an environment that upholds First Amendment rights, distinct from major technology corporations and conventional media outlets. Beyond its broadcasting arm, the corporation also oversees Banana Box Wholesale Grocery, a large-scale food distribution business. Additionally, MLMC manages the Leading Edge Radio Network, which produces diverse media and entertainment content, including radio programs, television shows, and motion pictures. This entity, previously known as FrankSpeech Network, Inc., rebranded as Mike Lindell Media, Corp. in April 2025. The company's main office is situated in Chaska, Minnesota.
